title: Google Hotels prices
description: Three row types share one dataset: hotel (lowest nightly rate and stay total per hotel), offer (one booking source's rate for a hotel and stay), status (per place or property and stay; never charged).

dataset.title: Google Hotels prices
dataset.description: Hotel price rows, per-source rate rows and status rows. Charged rows are billed as delivered; status rows are always free.

summary.title: Run summary
summary.description: One JSON record with the counts this run delivered and charged, its error and duplicate tallies, and its HTTP stats.
